cohort: 238,598 singleton pregnant women aged 10-34 years in the database of Hebei Province Maternal Near Miss Surveillance System (HBMNMSS) from January 1, 2013 to December 31, 2017
finding: Adolescent pregnancy, especially in younger adolescents, was associated with increased risks of adverse perinatal outcomes such as preterm delivery, stillbirth, and neonatal death.
mod_finding: Women aged 10-19 years had a lower risk of cesarean delivery compared to women aged 20-34 years.
